messages:
riley: Quick pass on a "Midnight Slate" dark baseline. Goal: softer blacks, clear 12px monospace, and charts that don't 'glow' on thumbnails. Initial tokens:
- --ms-bg: #0c0d10; --ms-panel: #121316; --ms-fg: #e7eaee; --ms-muted: #a1a9af; --ms-accent: #56bfff

nova: agree on softer blacks. Legend chips need separation on small screens. proposing .chip {background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);}

priya: contrast quick check: fg on bg ~7.0:1 good. muted ~3.4:1 so limit to microcopy. Add Storybook check: body>=4.5, label>=3.0.

sam: syntax palette (low-sat): keywords #84d0ff, strings #ffd5a8, funcs #d3bfff, comments #6e767e. Avoid bright greens. Charts: tonal series `#56bfff`, `#6eaed0`, `#95c6e6`, fills at 0.08 alpha.

riley: small CSS snippet I dropped in the prototype: ```css
:root{--ms-bg:#0c0d10;--ms-fg:#e7eaee;--chip-bg:rgba(0,0,0,0.22);--axis:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
.legend .chip{background:var(--chip-bg);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)}
```

priya: a11y nit: focus needs 3:1 against surface. recommend `box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(86,191,255,0.12)` plus visible label for toggles. Also add contrast-mode toggle (Default/High) that swaps muted and increases grid alpha.

design-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.design/midnight-slate-2 (build 429).

riley: next steps: nova posts color-blind sim, sam wires toggle prototype, priya adds Storybook checks. 15-min sync tomorrow. :calendar:
